reserveReview.rationale: The October 14, 2026 holdings CSV publishes eleven Treasury bills with market value USD 32,476,054.32 and four overnight Treasury repos totaling USD 20,000,000, for USD 52,476,054.32 total listed securities. Both slice weights use these published market values, not rounded par percentages. Repo counterparties are J.P. Morgan Securities, Credit Agricole CIB, BofA Securities and Mizuho Securities USA, each USD 5m, with October 15 maturities. Bills mature October 15, 2026 through January 14, 2027; the 93-day maximum is the prospectus mandate, not WAM. Stable source keys bind the two disclosed asset-type categories to the live adapter despite its different display names. Listed securities are not represented as total fund net assets: October 14 fund reporting rounds class/fund assets to USD 50.4m, while the October 15 Ethereum pin reports 50,355,489.68 shares and Tempo/Solana report zero. The gross-securities/net-assets difference is unreconciled, not a measured reserve surplus or shortfall. No whole-token financial assurance, account-level custody or executable redemption capacity is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: October 14, 2026 itemized securities holdings, normalized by exactly summed published security market values; excludes unreported cash and liabilities and is not a reserve-to-liability reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current whole-token liability reconciliation and account-level custody, collateral and recovery agreements remain unavailable. The October 14 disclosed securities total exceeds rounded fund net assets, but cash, other assets and liabilities are not included in the CSV. The September 30 N-MFP3 separately reports portfolio securities, cash, other assets, liabilities and shares; it does not reconcile the October observations. Named auditors do not establish a signed financial report.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The prospectus names BNY Mellon as fund custodian and accounting-services provider. SAI Part I states that BNY maintains custody accounts in the Fund's name and reconciles securities and cash positions with the custodian. These disclosed arrangements do not establish complete legal segregation, subcustody, account-level repo collateral safeguards or recovery rights across the whole book. October 14 holdings identify BofA Securities, Credit Agricole CIB, J.P. Morgan Securities and Mizuho Securities USA repo counterparties; complete custody shares and agreements remain unestablished.
